label_definition: event = VITAL_STATUS "Died of Disease"; non-event = "Living"; "Died of Other Causes" excluded

incremental_rule.rule: A capability stays on the delivered list only if the 95% CI of its incremental discrimination over the cheapest available comparator excludes zero.

fold_assignment_sensitivity.probe: OOF AUROC recomputed across 40 StratifiedKFold shuffle seeds, identical cohort/features/hyperparameters
fold_assignment_sensitivity.resolution: The 0.00163 gap is fold-assignment noise, not a specification difference. Cohort construction is confirmed exact: n, event count, NPI-alone AUROC and age-alone AUROC all reproduce bit-for-bit, and those are the two comparators that involve no cross-validated fitting.
fold_assignment_sensitivity.consequence: Quoting this AUROC to four decimals overstates precision. The defensible statement is OOF AUROC 0.71 +/- 0.002 (fold-assignment sd). The incremental verdict is unaffected: both CIs exclude zero under either fold draw.

deployment_caveats: Point estimate is fold-sensitive at +/-0.002; report as 0.71, not 0.7091.
Prognosis under the treatment mix present in METABRIC. Not a treatment-benefit estimate and not identifiable as one from this design.
All-cause claim was withdrawn: increment over NPI+age crossed zero. Only the disease-specific endpoint is supported.
ER-negative subgroup is underpowered: delta +0.0236, 95% CI crosses zero, p=0.136.
METABRIC is a retrospective cohort accrued 1977-2005; calibration to a contemporary population is unverified.
